name: LEDVANCE SMART+ Matter Plug (EU)

radios.note: Matter over 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi; LEDVANCE's GTIN page for 4099854295195 names it a Wi-Fi Matter plug. Bluetooth not confirmed either way.

matter.note: LEDVANCE says Matter 1.3 certified with energy metering over Matter. Matter Alpha lists SMART WIFI MAT PLUG EU WH, CSA24264MAT43287-24 (May 2024, fw 1.1.0); the CSA page itself wasn't seen.

apple_home.note: LEDVANCE lists Apple Home via Matter. Needs an Apple home hub as Matter controller.

google_home.note: LEDVANCE lists Google Home via Matter. Needs a Google Matter controller.

alexa.note: LEDVANCE lists Alexa via Matter. Needs an Echo that works as a Matter controller.

smartthings.note: LEDVANCE lists SmartThings via Matter. Needs a SmartThings Matter controller.

home_assistant.note: Through HA's Matter integration, as a certified Matter device; HA's docs don't name this plug.

hubRequired.note: The SMART+ app adds Matter over Wi-Fi devices without a gateway. Other ecosystems need their own Matter controller (speaker or hub).

localControl.note: Certified Matter device; HA says Matter devices are controlled locally without a vendor cloud. No LEDVANCE statement on offline app control found.

energyMonitoring.note: Built-in energy meter; the SMART+ app shows hourly (7 days), daily (365 days) and monthly use. LEDVANCE says metering is also exposed over Matter.

summary: LEDVANCE's SMART+ Matter Plug EU White is a Matter-over-Wi-Fi Schuko plug with an energy meter. LEDVANCE lists Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa and SmartThings via Matter, and Home Assistant can add it through its Matter integration. It is rated 2300 W / 10 A.
caveats: Rated 10 A / 2300 W, lower than many 16 A Schuko plugs.
LEDVANCE says schedules, timers and child lock are only available in the SMART+ app, not in other Matter apps.
